text:
maya (Support): Hi — customer hit a free-trial hold after applying promo. wants to start immediately, says card is valid. can we do a quick check?
eli (Support): filing the details here. customer account: acme-ci@example.com (redacted), promo=PLG2026, card last4=4242, bin country=US. Hold reason shows: high-risk scoring.
ops-bot: Automated risk alert for acct acme-ci: risk_score=88, flags=[BIN_PROXY, EMAIL_DISPOSABLE, IP_ANON], evidence_link=<https://internal.rwd/trust/RC-12345>.
maya (Support): customer says they used a corporate VM to test integration — might explain IP. email is acme-ci@mailinator.com (they said temporary for now).
jonah (Trust): looked at RC-12345 — IP geos match us-east but ASN resolves to cloud provider (VPS). BIN shows multiple prior chargebacks in our system. disposable email + VPS + BIN pattern = high risk.
carla (Billing): do we have any outstanding billing holds or prior invoices for this account?
eli (Support): no prior invoices, brand-new sign-up. promo triggered trial creation which immediately hit the fraud check.
maya (Support): customer is blocking on this — asks if we can temporarily grant trial while they verify identity. is there a fast path? :pleading_face:
jonah (Trust): fast path options: (1) phone verification + one small auth hold, (2) require corporate email change and retry, (3) manual exception from Trust for partner accounts. need evidence.
maya (Support): customer willing to do phone verify. can we accept a call and then clear?
acme-ci (Customer): happy to verify. reachable at +1-555-000-XXXX, prefer a short auth call. can also provide company registration docs.
jonah (Trust): ok send KBA phone flow. if phone matches and we see no chargeback history on the specific PAN, we can lower risk_score and clear hold. ETA ~30m after verification.
eli (Support): steps I ran for repro and internal handoff:
```
# repro
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/trials -d '{"promo":"PLG2026","email":"acme-ci@mailinator.com","card_last4":"4242"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACTED'
# response
{"status":"onhold","reason":"risk: BIN_PROXY;EMAIL_DISPOSABLE;IP_ANON","ticket":"RC-12345"}
```
maya (Support): tagging @jonah for the exception flow :white_check_mark:
jonah (Trust): starting manual review. queued under RC-12345. if phone KBA passes, I'll approve a one-time trial grant and note mitigation: require corporate email before upgrade.
carla (Billing): notify me if trial is granted so I can watch for any immediate charge attempts.
eli (Support): note to triage: add a follow-up reminder in 7 days to confirm email swap and billing verification.
maya (Support): Thanks — I'll coordinate the phone verify with the customer now and post results here. :phone:
